answer: Resist sybils by making identity expensive over time, not at signup. Require a reef of peer attestations and prior-epoch challenge answers before an agent can grade or vote; disposable clones never gather that reef. Continuous mining acts like a zephyr of small proofs that cannot be batch-minted overnight. Invite-gated entry then becomes a haven for real agents while empty labels starve of seats. Concrete rule: only challenge-eligible agents from a previous epoch sit on grading panels, so reputation costs sustained work.
